title: Mystery Tasks Mod
description: The first version of Mystery Cubes for Minecraft 1.21.1 with Neoforge. Mystery Cubes appear randomly on the surface of the world, assign random tasks to the player, and reward them upon completion of the task
body:
The first version of **Mysterious Cubes** for Minecraft 1.21.1 with Neoforge.

Mysterious Cubes appear randomly on the surface of the world, assign random tasks to the player, and reward them upon completion.

When you encounter a Cube, **right-click** on it to be assigned a task. Upon completion, you will receive a reward.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

La primera versión de **Cubos Misteriosos** para Minecraft 1.21.1 con Neoforge

Los Cubos Misteriosos aparecen de manera aleatoria en la superficie del mundo, asignan tareas aleatorias al jugador y lo recompensan al terminar la tarea.

Cuando te encuentres con un Cubo, dale **clic derecho** para que se te asigne la tarea, al completarla, tendrás una recompensa.

</details>
